summary: Frontend-only visual regression test of Cosechas pie charts in Plantaciones (PlantacionDetail.jsx). Verified both 'Calidades del lote' and 'Calidades por variedad' adopt the modern style used in Aplicaciones (gradient header + Apple icon, donuts with rounded corners/paddingAngle, center kg total, progress-bar legend). Verified NO percentage (%) text is shown anywhere in those two charts. Verified no regressions on the rest of the Cosechas tab.
critical_code_review_comments: PlantacionDetail.jsx is ~951 lines — recommended to split CosechasTab and the reusable ChartHeader into separate files for maintainability (>700 line guideline).

Recharts emits a 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warning on initial render (visible in console). Not blocking, but ResponsiveContainer parents in the page may briefly be 0px before layout. Consider auditing minWidth/minHeight to silence warnings.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded plantation with cosecha data (Albion 2380 kg, Alturas 924 kg, lote total 3304 kg).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 validated the visual-only refactor of the two donut charts in the Cosechas subtab of Plantaciones. Login → /dashboard/plantaciones → open first card → click data-testid='plant-tab-cosechas'. The charts to inspect are data-testid='plant-calidades-chart' and data-testid='plant-calidades-variedad-chart'. Both must show modern ChartHeader (blue→green gradient) + rounded donuts + kg labels only (NO '%' text). Regression elements verified working: plant-cosecha-unidad-cestas/kg toggles, cosecha-row table, plant-cosecha-consolidado, plant-rendimiento-card, plant-cosecha-serie/cosecha-serie-chart.
